adaptations: Shared canonical event/player identity and paired full-game pregame offers; same observation clock as champion.

forecast_metrics.uncertainty_note: Descriptive paired scores; correlated quarterbacks and repeated teams are not independent evidence.

comparison.note: Both models use the same resolved offers, decision time, game odds, and common starting/health checks. ROI uses separate first decisions since challenger launch. Forecast scores include held offers and one deterministic common book/line per QB.
